correctness.rationale: The degrees of the two polynomial maps from the parameter line are m and n, so the intermediate function field has index dividing gcd(m,n)=1. Integrality of the parameter and the degree-m minimal relation then give the asserted affine normalization. In the stated characteristics the distinct Chebyshev critical points with the same critical value give exactly (m-1)(n-1)/2 nodes with nonsingular quadratic tangent cones. I checked label completeness directly: for any 1<=a<mn divisible by neither m nor n, choose k,l in the specified ranges with A=kn+lm congruent to a modulo mn. Either A represents a modulo 2mn or the B-label with k replaced by m-k does, because that label is A-mn. Conversely the proposed branches are different modulo sign, have the same image, and their indices are divisible by neither m nor n, so neither image coordinate is an endpoint and both are critical. The free involution (k,l)->(m-k,n-l) duplicates the unordered pairs; the preimage count proves there are no further identifications. Frobenius powers the roots of unity, and the nodal factor is the integral branch-ratio torus, with inversion exactly for a swap. The conductor unit quotient at the unique geometric branch at infinity has no torus, since the residue-unit factors cancel and only principal-unit quotients remain; Pic^0 of the normalization is zero. Positive and negative signed cycles give respectively the induced trivial and quadratic-sign integral lattices, not just rational factors. The normalization correction per rational node is 1 minus its number of rational preimages, which gives the signs in the point counts and both zeta formulas. Independent finite-field enumeration of the worked example returned 10 and 42 points and confirmed the seven distinct labeled nodes and signed orbit types.
